method: Direct inspection of this packet render, sourceContent, and requiredImages; no other reviews or automatic diagnostics read

findings: No visible text collision, panel overflow, or off-canvas content. Source screenshot and its caption are separated from the right-side explanation cards.
Slide headings, traceability labels, baseline statement, and bottom deliverable sentence are readable.
Dense spreadsheet cell text and small AI-panel text are too small for reliable reading at this render size; source-image detail readability remains limited.

required_images.observation: Spreadsheet ribbon, inventory rows, AI sidebar, and bottom workbook controls are visible without overlay or obvious cropping. Exact pixel identity was not separately verified.

style.observation: Balanced image-left and structured-card-right composition with consistent mint and teal accents.

content_visibility.observation: Caption separates the depicted inventory/AI interface from full automatic tracing proof. Geometry is acceptable. Small screenshot text is a limitation, not an explicit acceptance gate in this packet.

criteria_basis.summary: Requires complete screenshot and AI-panel preservation in a large landscape panel without overlap. No explicit all-microtext readability gate. Earlier partial verdict based solely on small screenshot text was overstrict and is corrected.
